Calls down 11 waves of fire on the target area, each dealing 65 damage to units in it. If Varimathras channels to the end, an Infernal crashes down at the centre, dealing 195 damage to nearby enemy units, stunning them for 1 second and leaving fel fire that burns them for 30 damage per second for 5 seconds.
